# Partner Marketing Manager

## Location

Remote

## Employment Type

Full time

## Location Type

Remote

## Department

Commercial Operations RiskMarketing

## Compensation

- $175K – $225K • Offers Equity

## **Who We Are**

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, [Booking.com](http://booking.com/), H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

**Partner Marketing Manager**

**Role Summary**

As Partner Marketing Manager, you will own the full marketing strategy and growth outcomes for several of Imprint's largest co-branded credit card partnerships. You are the marketing leader for your partners: the person accountable for how we acquire, activate, and retain cardholders across every channel, and the person partners look to as the strategic marketing mind behind their program.

You will operate as the CMO for your assigned partners: leading annual marketing planning in lockstep with General Managers and partner executives, owning full-funnel performance from application through long-term retention, and driving high-impact campaign strategy and execution across paid, owned, and partner channels. This role requires someone who can move fluidly between strategic planning and hands-on technical execution, who earns credibility with senior partner stakeholders, and who builds marketing programs that compound in quality and impact as Imprint scales its co-branded portfolio.

**What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days**

- Built and presented a 12-month marketing plan for each assigned partner with quarterly execution detail, investment priorities, and measurable growth targets, aligned with GMs and partner marketing leadership

- Completed a diagnostic assessment of each partner's full-funnel performance (application through retention), identified the highest leverage opportunities, and built a prioritized optimization roadmap with clear sequencing

- Created a partner marketing playbook defining audience segmentation, positioning, messaging architecture, and channel strategy that serves as the strategic foundation for internal creative and campaign teams and holds up in senior partner conversations

- Launched or meaningfully iterated on campaigns in at least two channels (lifecycle, paid social, direct mail, affiliate) with measurable performance improvements and a clear point of view on what to scale next

- Established yourself as a trusted strategic partner to GMs, Lifecycle Managers, product, engineering, marketing analytics, and partner marketing leadership

- Demonstrated technical depth in campaign deployment tools and workflows, with the credibility to make architectural decisions about how campaigns are built and delivered


**Responsibilities**

_Marketing Strategy and Growth Ownership_

- Own marketing strategy, planning, execution, and performance for major co-branded partners, with direct accountability for partner growth outcomes including acquisition volume, activation, spend, and retention

- Lead the development of 12-month marketing roadmaps in partnership with GMs, including quarterly planning cycles, budget allocation, and investment tradeoff decisions

- Present marketing strategy and performance to partner marketing leadership and internal executives, owning the growth narrative for your assigned programs

- Identify and prioritize the highest leverage opportunities across the funnel and make investment recommendations based on performance data, partner dynamics, and competitive landscape


_Acquisition and Campaign Strategy_

- Design, lead, and optimize acquisition campaigns across paid channels (paid social, paid search, affiliate, direct mail) and owned channels (lifecycle, in-app, email)

- Develop and own experimentation frameworks that systematically improve CAC, LTV, and partner-specific KPIs, with a rigorous approach to test design, measurement, and learning

- Build audience segmentation, positioning, and messaging strategies that sharpen creative execution, strengthen partner channel marketing, and drive measurable lift in conversion

- Make channel mix and budget allocation decisions based on performance data, and have the judgment to shift resources quickly when the data warrants it


_Full-Funnel Optimization_

- Partner with Lifecycle Managers and analytics to own full-funnel performance: application rate, approval rate, activation rate, spend behavior, insurance attach, and retention

- Diagnose funnel breakdowns and lead cross-functional efforts to resolve them, working across product, engineering, analytics, and lifecycle to ship improvements

- Build and maintain a clear performance story for each partner: what's working, what's not, where the leverage is, and what the plan is


_Partner Relationship and Influence_

- Serve as the senior marketing point of contact for assigned partners, building trust and credibility with partner marketing leadership through strategic depth and consistent delivery

- Translate partner objectives and commercial goals into actionable marketing strategies that create value for both Imprint and the partner

- Bring a clear, data-informed point of view into partner conversations and the strategic credibility to shape joint marketing decisions, not just execute on partner requests

- Set expectations with partners on what's realistic, what's working, and where we should invest next, and have the conviction to push back when needed


_Vendor and Cross-Functional Leadership_

- Own relationships with external vendors (affiliate platforms, direct mail bureaus, media agencies) and lead vendor performance management, negotiation, and strategic alignment

- Drive cross-functional alignment with product, engineering, analytics, and creative to ensure marketing programs are executed with speed and quality

- Identify gaps in marketing infrastructure, tooling, or process and lead initiatives to improve campaign deployment speed, quality, and scalability


_Measurement and Reporting_

- Own the measurement framework and reporting cadence for assigned partners, tracking application volume, approval rate, activation rate, insurance attach, partner revenue, retention, and LTV

- Lead performance reviews with internal stakeholders and partner teams, translating data into clear narratives and actionable recommendations

- Use performance insights to continuously refine strategy, reallocate investment, and raise the bar on what good looks like across the portfolio


**Qualifications**

**Required**

- 7 to 10+ years of growth marketing or partner marketing experience in financial services or fintech, with a track record of leading (not just supporting) the launch and scaling of products or partnerships

- Deep technical knowledge of marketing workflows across paid and owned channels, including lifecycle campaign deployment through tools like Braze, with the ability to make architectural and workflow decisions

- Experience with affiliate platforms (Impact, AWIN) and paid acquisition channels (paid social, paid search), with demonstrated ability to optimize channel mix and manage meaningful media budgets

- Strong analytical skills with proven experience diagnosing funnel performance, designing experiments, and optimizing CAC, approval rates, activation rates, LTV, and retention at scale

- Proven ability to build marketing plans, experimentation frameworks, and funnel optimization strategies in close partnership with cross-functional teams, and the leadership skills to drive alignment and accountability

- Track record of building trust and credibility with senior partner stakeholders, with the ability to represent Imprint's marketing strategy at the executive level

- Exceptional communicator who can translate complex partner objectives into clear marketing strategies, and who can present confidently to both internal leadership and external partner teams


**Nice to Have**

- Growth marketing depth: experience leading performance media campaigns end to end with a strong command of CAC optimization, paid media strategy, and budget management across multiple channels

- Direct mail expertise: experience deploying pre-screen direct mail or ITA campaigns, including working with data providers (TransUnion, Axiom) and direct mail vendors (DMS)

- Experience in high-growth startups or scaling marketing programs in resource-constrained environments where you had to build the playbook while shipping at speed

- Familiarity with product marketing for new product launches, not just management of existing programs, and comfort operating in ambiguity during early-stage go-to-market


## **Perks & Benefits**

- Competitive compensation and equity packages

- Leading configured work computers of your choice

- Flexible paid time off

- Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

- Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA

- 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

- Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity


_Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together._

Compensation Range: $175K - $225K

 - Develop and own experimentation frameworks that systematically improve CAC, LTV, and partner-specific KPIs, with a rigorous approach to test design, measurement, and learning

 - Build audience segmentation, positioning, and messaging strategies that sharpen creative execution, strengthen partner channel marketing, and drive measurable lift in conversion

 - Diagnose funnel breakdowns and lead cross-functional efforts to resolve them, working across product, engineering, analytics, and lifecycle to ship improvements

WHO WE ARE

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com http://Booking.com, H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank. 

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

Partner Marketing Manager

Role Summary

As Partner Marketing Manager, you will own the full marketing strategy and growth outcomes for several of Imprint's largest co-branded credit card partnerships. You are the marketing leader for your partners: the person accountable for how we acquire, activate, and retain cardholders across every channel, and the person partners look to as the strategic marketing mind behind their program.

You will operate as the CMO for your assigned partners: leading annual marketing planning in lockstep with General Managers and partner executives, owning full-funnel performance from application through long-term retention, and driving high-impact campaign strategy and execution across paid, owned, and partner channels. This role requires someone who can move fluidly between strategic planning and hands-on technical execution, who earns credibility with senior partner stakeholders, and who builds marketing programs that compound in quality and impact as Imprint scales its co-branded portfolio.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

 - Built and presented a 12-month marketing plan for each assigned partner with quarterly execution detail, investment priorities, and measurable growth targets, aligned with GMs and partner marketing leadership

 - Completed a diagnostic assessment of each partner's full-funnel performance (application through retention), identified the highest leverage opportunities, and built a prioritized optimization roadmap with clear sequencing

 - Created a partner marketing playbook defining audience segmentation, positioning, messaging architecture, and channel strategy that serves as the strategic foundation for internal creative and campaign teams and holds up in senior partner conversations

 - Launched or meaningfully iterated on campaigns in at least two channels (lifecycle, paid social, direct mail, affiliate) with measurable performance improvements and a clear point of view on what to scale next

 - Established yourself as a trusted strategic partner to GMs, Lifecycle Managers, product, engineering, marketing analytics, and partner marketing leadership

 - Demonstrated technical depth in campaign deployment tools and workflows, with the credibility to make architectural decisions about how campaigns are built and delivered

Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy and Growth Ownership

 - Own marketing strategy, planning, execution, and performance for major co-branded partners, with direct accountability for partner growth outcomes including acquisition volume, activation, spend, and retention

 - Lead the development of 12-month marketing roadmaps in partnership with GMs, including quarterly planning cycles, budget allocation, and investment tradeoff decisions

 - Present marketing strategy and performance to partner marketing leadership and internal executives, owning the growth narrative for your assigned programs

 - Identify and prioritize the highest leverage opportunities across the funnel and make investment recommendations based on performance data, partner dynamics, and competitive landscape

Acquisition and Campaign Strategy

 - Design, lead, and optimize acquisition campaigns across paid channels (paid social, paid search, affiliate, direct mail) and owned channels (lifecycle, in-app, email)

 - Develop and own experimentation frameworks that systematically improve CAC, LTV, and partner-specific KPIs, with a rigorous approach to test design, measurement, and learning

 - Build audience segmentation, positioning, and messaging strategies that sharpen creative execution, strengthen partner channel marketing, and drive measurable lift in conversion

 - Make channel mix and budget allocation decisions based on performance data, and have the judgment to shift resources quickly when the data warrants it

Full-Funnel Optimization

 - Partner with Lifecycle Managers and analytics to own full-funnel performance: application rate, approval rate, activation rate, spend behavior, insurance attach, and retention

 - Diagnose funnel breakdowns and lead cross-functional efforts to resolve them, working across product, engineering, analytics, and lifecycle to ship improvements

 - Build and maintain a clear performance story for each partner: what's working, what's not, where the leverage is, and what the plan is

Partner Relationship and Influence

 - Serve as the senior marketing point of contact for assigned partners, building trust and credibility with partner marketing leadership through strategic depth and consistent delivery

 - Translate partner objectives and commercial goals into actionable marketing strategies that create value for both Imprint and the partner

 - Bring a clear, data-informed point of view into partner conversations and the strategic credibility to shape joint marketing decisions, not just execute on partner requests

 - Set expectations with partners on what's realistic, what's working, and where we should invest next, and have the conviction to push back when needed

Vendor and Cross-Functional Leadership

 - Own relationships with external vendors (affiliate platforms, direct mail bureaus, media agencies) and lead vendor performance management, negotiation, and strategic alignment

 - Drive cross-functional alignment with product, engineering, analytics, and creative to ensure marketing programs are executed with speed and quality

 - Identify gaps in marketing infrastructure, tooling, or process and lead initiatives to improve campaign deployment speed, quality, and scalability

Measurement and Reporting

 - Own the measurement framework and reporting cadence for assigned partners, tracking application volume, approval rate, activation rate, insurance attach, partner revenue, retention, and LTV

 - Lead performance reviews with internal stakeholders and partner teams, translating data into clear narratives and actionable recommendations

 - Use performance insights to continuously refine strategy, reallocate investment, and raise the bar on what good looks like across the portfolio

Qualifications

Required

 - 7 to 10+ years of growth marketing or partner marketing experience in financial services or fintech, with a track record of leading (not just supporting) the launch and scaling of products or partnerships

 - Deep technical knowledge of marketing workflows across paid and owned channels, including lifecycle campaign deployment through tools like Braze, with the ability to make architectural and workflow decisions

 - Experience with affiliate platforms (Impact, AWIN) and paid acquisition channels (paid social, paid search), with demonstrated ability to optimize channel mix and manage meaningful media budgets

 - Strong analytical skills with proven experience diagnosing funnel performance, designing experiments, and optimizing CAC, approval rates, activation rates, LTV, and retention at scale

 - Proven ability to build marketing plans, experimentation frameworks, and funnel optimization strategies in close partnership with cross-functional teams, and the leadership skills to drive alignment and accountability

 - Track record of building trust and credibility with senior partner stakeholders, with the ability to represent Imprint's marketing strategy at the executive level

 - Exceptional communicator who can translate complex partner objectives into clear marketing strategies, and who can present confidently to both internal leadership and external partner teams

Nice to Have

 - Growth marketing depth: experience leading performance media campaigns end to end with a strong command of CAC optimization, paid media strategy, and budget management across multiple channels

 - Direct mail expertise: experience deploying pre-screen direct mail or ITA campaigns, including working with data providers (TransUnion, Axiom) and direct mail vendors (DMS)

 - Experience in high-growth startups or scaling marketing programs in resource-constrained environments where you had to build the playbook while shipping at speed

 - Familiarity with product marketing for new product launches, not just management of existing programs, and comfort operating in ambiguity during early-stage go-to-market


PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation and equity packages

 - Leading configured work computers of your choice

 - Flexible paid time off

 - Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

 - Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the  option to enroll in an FSA

 - 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

 - Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.
